body.objective: Close the first spectator-overlap stratum of the BT three-particle detector by constructing an exact hard nonforward configuration with one and only one identity spectator, proving that the unique order-lambda2 contribution is the physical four-point tree tensored with that spectator, and deriving its complete leading probability coefficient.
activates: a complete leading physical coefficient on the first disconnected spectator stratum
an exact positive factorization of the four-point generalized-Born jet
a two-stratum hard nonforward physical atlas when combined with the fully rearranged theorem
body.current_gate: Exhibit exact massless three-to-three momenta with exactly one vanishing two-component momentum sum and no vanishing one- or three-component sum; enumerate all supported set partitions; reconstruct the physical four-point mass-jet norm and Born coefficient; and prove that forward, connected six-point, and loop terms enter only above the leading probability order.
body.stop_condition: Land an exact certificate and method-distinct verifier for the unique tagged-spectator support, order classification, positive four-point jet factorization, complete leading lambda4 detector probability, and all Eq. 19, all-time, gravity, and Lorentzian boundaries.
body.forbid: no tagged-spectator leading coefficient called a global all-channel S matrix; no Born cross section called a packet-independent probability without the declared beam area; no order-lambda4 probability called loop-complete; no reduced-mode result called Eq. 19, gravity, BV/BRST, or LORENTZIAN-CAUSAL physics; no literature-priority claim
body.resource_hint: Rotate the exact input momenta by Rx(15/16), retain p0 as k0, and rotate the active p1,p2 pair by ninety degrees before the same common rotation. In all-incoming convention the sole zero two-subset is {p0,-k0}; every one- and three-subset is nonzero. The active invariants are s=64/25 and t=u=-32/25. The reduced four-point tree has M4/lambda2=2 sum_(i<j) x_i x_j, whose complement-pairing norm is 24 and gives the public 3/(32 pi2 s) Born coefficient.
